_meta.purpose: SLAP reaction-GIF library. Curated, verified GIF assets keyed by a stable Giphy ID. The GIF selector (Sonnet) matches the writer's gif_concept against these entries; live Giphy search is a FALLBACK only when nothing here fits. This mirrors the CURATED_TEMPLATES model in generate_memes.py — but for GIFs.
_meta.status: DRAFT FORMAT PROPOSAL — real seed examples added 2026-08-23. Still not wired into the pipeline.
_meta.how_giphy_id_works: For a share-page URL like giphy.com/gifs/{slug}-{ID} (or giphy.com/gifs/{ID} with no slug), the ID is the final token after the last hyphen. That ID is the same one Giphy's API uses for lookup.
_meta.canonical_url_PROBED_2026-08-23: A clean https://i.giphy.com/media/<id>/giphy.gif does NOT exist — disproved by probe. Giphy's real media URLs require a context-dependent cid blob (media{N}.giphy.com/media/v1.{cid}/<id>/giphy.gif), matching the long URLs already seen in gif_history.json. DO NOT hand-construct the render URL from the ID. Instead, resolve the ID at embed time via Giphy's get-by-ID endpoint: GET https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/{id}?api_key=... — this returns the same 'images' object shape that fetch_giphy_candidates() in generate_newsletter.py already parses for search results, so the existing URL-extraction logic (images.downsized_medium / downsized / original) can be reused as-is for library lookups. The library only needs to store the bare ID; resolution is one small new function that mirrors the existing search path.

verification_states.verified: A human (Abram) has confirmed this IS the intended clip, clean (no random caption overlay), good quality. Entries below marked verified are Abram's own picks from the 2026-08-23 seeding round.
verification_states.candidate: AI-proposed during library expansion. NOT yet human-reviewed. The selector MAY use these only if allow_candidates is on; default is verified-only.
verification_states.retired: Was in rotation, pulled by feedback. Kept in the file (not deleted) so expansion doesn't re-propose it. Never selected.

_meta.selection_contract: Selector receives: the writer's gif_concept string + the list of entries whose category matches AND that are not in cooldown AND status=verified. It returns one entry id, or the sentinel NO_MATCH to trigger Giphy fallback. It must NOT invent an id.

escalation.description: It keeps getting better / worse — each beat tops the last. Stat lines piling up, a situation compounding.
escalation.use_when: A story where intensity ratchets: blowup trades stacking, a team's problems compounding, records falling one after another.
escalation.do_not_use_when: A single flat fact. Escalation needs a sequence to land.

betrayal_self_sabotage.description: A team, player, or org turning on itself - infighting, an own-goal, a self-inflicted collapse from within.
betrayal_self_sabotage.use_when: Locker room drama, a coach undermining his own player, an own-goal, a team beating itself rather than being beaten.
betrayal_self_sabotage.do_not_use_when: The mistake is a simple external error with no 'turning on your own side' angle - that's bad_dumb_move.

fatigue_over_it.description: Worn out, over it, done — weariness from repetition, not grief from a loss.
fatigue_over_it.use_when: A fanbase or voter bloc tired of hearing the same story, 'we do this every year' exhaustion, a player visibly gassed, the collective eye-roll at a narrative that will not end.
fatigue_over_it.do_not_use_when: The feeling is grief or defeat after a specific loss — that's sadness_resignation. Or it's active fury rather than weariness — that's anger_outrage.
